method: Operator site read directly on 2026-09-13. The plan your visit page states the venue is open every day of the year and refers the reader to this page for trading hours.
note: The operator publishes trading hours per facility, not one set for the site. The Bath House is Monday to Friday 7am to 11pm and Saturday and Sunday 5am to 11pm; the Spa Dreaming Centre and the Amphitheatre carry their own. The record's opening times match the Bath House exactly and its 11pm closes match on Monday to Thursday and Sunday. Its 2am closes on Friday and Saturday do not: the operator publishes a 2am finish only for Moonlit Bathing, a separate Friday and Saturday 10pm to 2am session, and the Bath House still closes at 11pm on those nights. The record flattens a distinct ticketed session into the venue's general opening hours, which is the field that reaches JSON-LD, so a reader arriving at midnight on a Friday without a Moonlit booking is told the venue is open when the bath house is shut.
